source: real S05 R4 JTAG/VIO mailbox; six 104-word scans
time_conversion: cycles / 50 microseconds; nominal board clock, not an independent oscillator calibration
primary_timing_scope: ticks bracket the complete hardware_crc call: ABORT/configuration, CPU loads and MMIO feeding, tail packing, polling, status/error checks, result read, return and tick sampling overhead
engine_scope: START acceptance through final-byte processing; includes CPU feeding gaps; not pure isolated CRC compute time
statistics_policy: All three runs shown. Mean/min/max and signed differences retained; no best-run selection or timing subtraction.
timing_excludes: Payload generation, bitwise reference CRC, mailbox writes and JTAG host scan are outside both timed calls.
